name: Black Mountain Center for the Arts
addr: 225 W State St, Black Mountain, NC 28711

reviews.t: Wonderful intimate venue for live storytelling, poetry, and music. The upstairs gallery always has something engaging on display as well.

The annual Art in Bloom event at the Black Mountain Center for the Arts is a singular experience in our area to see elaborate floral designs in concert with the art pieces that inspired them. Plus, you have the opportunity to meet the artists and designers in person. There are other events, like a garden crawl and plein air painters, however, due to a trip out of state, I could only attend the studio event, so I can't sing praises for the other activities. I'm sure they were as well or even more rewarding for all the participants and observers. Highly recommended!
Right in the heart of Black Mountain. Small but interesting. Walking around downtown this was a nice little stop to learn about some history of the area and famous people from there.
I took a mosaic class this weekend and had the best time. The instructor, Lena, was great and I enjoyed meeting other artsy and crafty people. Looking forward to returning.

The Black Mountain Center for the Arts is located in Downtown Black Mountain. It is in the former City Hall Building. Stairs are the only option to get to the second-floor gallery as the elevator was damaged by Hurricane Helene. Parking is on the street and in public lots. I found out about the Art in Bloom exhibit that was happening and made sure to fit it into my plans. The artwork and flower displays were upstairs. I was there the last day, and they still looked amazing. I was thrilled I got to see the creativity. The staff was very friendly and welcoming here, and even provided me with a tour of the facility. The Center has performing arts so I joined the mailing list so I could find out about upcoming theatre performances and concerts. Classes and workshops are offered too. This is a great asset to the community.
Art in Bloom was terrific. You don’t want to miss this!

I had a wonderful time in Black Mountain. Performing at the Center was just the frosting on the cake. It's small, but very well setup to provide a real local Arts experience. The photography currently showing in the upstairs gallery are magnificent. Check out the pieces by Herb Way.

The summer camps are fantastic! My shy 4yo mamas girl, despite having a tough time with drop off on Monday, came home the same day saying “that was really fun” and enjoyed the rest of the week without any fuss! Highly recommend 🥰 …

I moved from Museum City in Georgia and grew up at the High Museum of Art in Atlanta. I am not easily impressed but this place surprised me and made me feel like I was at home. I have seen a production in their theater, been to an event in their gallery, and am looking forward to a pottery class. Don't miss this little gem.
Awesome theatre Frankie and Johnny , enjoyed the galleries too
